ops.title: WAL checkpoint starvation under parallel sessions
ops.content: When two sessions write concurrently, the TRUNCATE checkpoint starves; symptom is an ever-growing -wal file.

connect_to.title: e5f6a7b8
connect_to.why: Checkpoint starvation is a direct downstream effect of the WAL writer-slot contention described in the SQLite write contention lesson — contention prevents the checkpoint from completing, causing the -wal file to grow unboundedly.
